metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 TransitGateway activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "AcceptTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment", "Set", "Transit Gateway Client VPN Attachment",
  "AcceptTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
  "AcceptTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
  "CreateTransitGateway", "Create", "Transit Gateway",
  "CreateTransitGatewayConnect", "Create", "Transit Gateway Connect",
  "CreateTransitGatewayConnectPeer", "Create", "Transit Gateway Connect Peer",
  "CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "Create", "Transit Gateway Peering Attachment",
  "CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "Create", "Transit Gateway",
  "DeleteTransitGateway", "Delete", "Transit Gateway",
  "DeleteTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Client VPN Attachment",
  "DeleteTransitGatewayConnect", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Connect",
  "DeleteTransitGatewayConnectPeer", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Connect Peer",
  "DeleteTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "Delete", "Transit Gateway Peering Attachment",
  "DeleteTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "Delete", "Transit Gateway VPC Attachment",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments", "Read", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayConnectPeers", "Read", "Transit Gateway Connect Peer",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayConnects", "Read", "Transit Gateway Connect",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayMeteringPolicies", "Read", "Transit Gateway Metering Policy",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayPeeringAttachments", "Read", "Transit Gateway Peering Attachment",
  "DescribeTransitGatewayVpcAttachments", "Read", "Transit Gateway VPC Attachment",
  "DescribeTransitGateways", "Read", "Transit Gateway",
  "GetTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration", "Read", "Transit Gateway Attachment NAT Configuration",
  "ModifyTransitGateway", "Set", "Transit Gateway",
  "ModifyTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration", "Set", "Transit Gateway Attachment NAT Configuration",
  "ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "Set", "Transit Gateway VPC Attachment",
  "RejectTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment", "Set", "Transit Gateway Client VPN Attachment",
  "RejectTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "Execute", "Transit Gateway Attachment",
  "RejectTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "Execute", "Transit Gateway VPC Attachment"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment", "RejectTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment"),
      Resp.transitGatewayClientVpnAttachment,
    EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment",
      "RejectTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment"), Resp.transitGatewayPeeringAttachment,
    EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment",
      "ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "RejectTransitGatewayVpcAttachment"),
      Resp.transitGatewayVpcAttachment,
    EventName in ("CreateTransitGateway", "ModifyTransitGateway"), Resp.transitGateway,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayConnect", Resp.transitGatewayConnect,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayConnectPeer", Resp.transitGatewayConnectPeer,
    EventName == "ModifyTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration", bag_pack("natGatewayRuleSet",
      Resp.natGatewayRuleSet, "natGatewaySupport", Resp.natGatewaySupport,
      "natSystemRouteSupport", Resp.natSystemRouteSupport),
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment", "DeleteTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment",
      "GetTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration", "ModifyTransitGatewayAttachmentNatConfiguration",
      "RejectTransitGatewayClientVpnAttachment"), coalesce(Req.transitGatewayAttachmentId,
      Req.TransitGatewayAttachmentId),
    EventName in ("AcceptTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "AcceptTransitGatewayVpcAttachment",
      "DeleteTransitGatewayConnect", "DeleteTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment",
      "DeleteTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment",
      "RejectTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment", "RejectTransitGatewayVpcAttachment"),
      Req.TransitGatewayAttachmentId,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGateway", Resp.transitGateway.transitGatewayId,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayConnect",
      Resp.transitGatewayConnect.transitGatewayGonnectId,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayConnectPeer",
      Resp.transitGatewayConnectPeer.transitGatewayConnectPeerId,
    EventName == "CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment",
      Resp.transitGatewayPeeringAttachment.transitGatewayPeeringAttachmentId,
    EventName in ("CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment", "DeleteTransitGateway", "ModifyTransitGateway"),
      Req.TransitGatewayId,
    EventName == "DeleteTransitGatewayConnectPeer", Req.TransitGatewayConnectPeerId,
    EventName in ("DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments", "DescribeTransitGatewayPeeringAttachments",
      "DescribeTransitGatewayVpcAttachments"), Req.TransitGatewayAttachmentIds,
    EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayConnectPeers", Req.TransitGatewayConnectPeerIds,
    EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayConnects", Req.TransitGatewayMeteringPolicyIds,
    EventName == "DescribeTransitGatewayMeteringPolicies", Req.TransitGatewayMulticastDomainIds,
    EventName == "DescribeTransitGateways", Req.TransitGatewayIds,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
